授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本授業では、科学的な内容を英語で効果的に伝えるために必要な実践的コミュニケーション能力を身につけることを目的とする。科学論文やレポートなどの基本的な構成と科学英語による文章表現を学ぶとともに、研究内容や科学的データを、研究者および一般の人々を含むさまざまな聴衆に対して明確かつ適切に伝える方法を習得する。また、英語による口頭発表の構成、効果的なプレゼンテーション方法、および質疑応答の方法を実践的に学ぶ。これらの講義と演習を通して、科学的な内容を英語で論理的かつ分かりやすく表現し、文章および口頭の両方で効果的にコミュニケーションできる能力の向上を目指す。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course aims to develop students' practical skills in communicating scientific information effectively in English. Students will learn the basic structure and writing conventions of scientific papers and reports, as well as how to communicate research findings and scientific data clearly and appropriately to various audiences, including researchers and the general public. The course also provides practical training in organizing and delivering effective oral presentations and responding appropriately and concisely to questions. Through lectures and practical exercises, students will develop their ability to communicate scientific information logically and clearly in both written and oral forms.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Scientific communication; Scientific writing; Scientific presentations; Academic English; Oral communication; Data presentation
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: No specific prerequisites are required. Students should be able to understand lectures and participate in class activities conducted in English.

授業科目の実施方法について.テキスト: No specific textbook is required. Lecture slides, selected scientific papers, and other course materials will be provided by the instructor.
授業科目の実施方法について.参考書等:
(1) Glasman-Deal, H. Science Research Writing for Non-Native Speakers of English. Imperial College Press, 2010.
(2) Alley, M. The Craft of Scientific Presentations: Critical Steps to Succeed and Critical Errors to Avoid. Springer, 2013.
(3) Hanganu-Bresch, C. & Flaherty, K. Effective Scientific Communication: The Other Half of Science. Oxford University Press, 2020.
Additional scientific papers and other relevant materials will be introduced or provided during the course.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Students are expected to attend all class sessions and actively participate in course activities.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: Students will be evaluated based on their ability to communicate scientific information clearly, logically, and appropriately in written and oral forms.

授業科目に関する学習相談について.担当教員による学習相談: Students are encouraged to actively participate in all lectures and practical activities. Selected scientific papers from different research fields will be used to examine scientific writing styles, paper organization, and journal-specific requirements. For the assignment, students will select a scientific topic of their interest, prepare a written abstract, and give an oral presentation on the selected topic. As the course is conducted in English, students should make an effort to communicate in English during class activities and presentations. Prior experience in scientific writing or oral presentation is not required.
